examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The intended entry point: a large search field with a ⌘K hint that opens the palette via `v-model:open`, plus the global `meta+k` (⌘K / Ctrl+K) shortcut. Inside, a "Suggestions" group of plain-label items and a "Commands" group whose items carry ⌘ shortcut hints rendered via Kbd.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Command from '@aziontech/webkit/command'
  import CommandGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/command-group'
  import CommandInput from '@aziontech/webkit/command-input'
  import CommandItem from '@aziontech/webkit/command-item'
  import CommandList from '@aziontech/webkit/command-list'
  import CommandSeparator from '@aziontech/webkit/command-separator'
  import SearchTrigger from '@aziontech/webkit/search-trigger'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <SearchTrigger @open="open = true" />

  <Command
    v-model:open="open"
    shortcut="meta+k"
  >
    <CommandInput placeholder="Search commands…" />
    <CommandList>
      <CommandGroup heading="Suggestions">
        <CommandItem value="deploy">Deploy Project</CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="new-app">Create Application</CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="settings">Go to Settings</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
      <CommandSeparator />
      <CommandGroup heading="Commands">
        <CommandItem
          value="search"
          shortcut="meta+k"
          >Search everything</CommandItem
        >
        <CommandItem
          value="new-app-cmd"
          shortcut="meta+n"
          >New Application</CommandItem
        >
        <CommandItem
          value="toggle-theme"
          shortcut="meta+shift+l"
          >Toggle Theme</CommandItem
        >
      </CommandGroup>
    </CommandList>
  </Command>
</template>

examples.name: Grouped
examples.summary: Three labeled groups — the central grouping anatomy — showing both spacings: `--spacing-sm` above a `CommandSeparator` and `--spacing-xs` below it, and `--spacing-sm` between two groups with no separator between them. Half the items carry a `prefix` icon and half do not; the leading box is rendered only by the rows that supply a glyph, so an icon-less row puts no empty element in the DOM and carries no indent. Opens from a button; `shortcut=""` opts out of the global binding so only Default owns ⌘K on this page.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import Command from '@aziontech/webkit/command'
  import CommandInput from '@aziontech/webkit/command-input'
  import CommandList from '@aziontech/webkit/command-list'
  import CommandGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/command-group'
  import CommandItem from '@aziontech/webkit/command-item'
  import CommandSeparator from '@aziontech/webkit/command-separator'
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    label="Open grouped palette"
    kind="primary"
    @click="open = true"
  />

  <Command
    v-model:open="open"
    shortcut=""
  >
    <CommandInput placeholder="Search commands…" />
    <CommandList>
      <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
        <CommandItem value="deploy">
          <template #prefix
            ><i
              class="pi pi-cloud-upload"
              aria-hidden="true"
          /></template>
          Deploy Project
        </CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="new-app">Create Application</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
      <CommandSeparator />
      <CommandGroup heading="Navigation">
        <CommandItem value="settings">
          <template #prefix
            ><i
              class="pi pi-cog"
              aria-hidden="true"
          /></template>
          Go to Settings
        </CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="billing">Go to Billing</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
      <CommandGroup heading="Account">
        <CommandItem value="profile">
          <template #prefix
            ><i
              class="pi pi-user"
              aria-hidden="true"
          /></template>
          View Profile
        </CommandItem>
        <CommandItem value="logout">Log Out</CommandItem>
      </CommandGroup>
    </CommandList>
  </Command>
</template>

examples.name: WithShortcuts
examples.summary: Items carrying keyboard-shortcut hints rendered on the right via Kbd. The item `shortcut` is display only — it does not register a binding. Opens from a button; `shortcut=""` on the root opts out of the global binding.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import Command from '@aziontech/webkit/command'
  import CommandInput from '@aziontech/webkit/command-input'
  import CommandList from '@aziontech/webkit/command-list'
  import CommandGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/command-group'
  import CommandItem from '@aziontech/webkit/command-item'
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    label="Open palette with shortcuts"
    kind="primary"
    @click="open = true"
  />

  <Command
    v-model:open="open"
    shortcut=""
  >
    <CommandInput placeholder="Search commands…" />
    <CommandList>
      <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
        <CommandItem
          value="command"
          shortcut="meta+k"
          >Open Command Menu</CommandItem
        >
        <CommandItem
          value="command-palette"
          shortcut="meta+shift+p"
          >Open Command Palette</CommandItem
        >
        <CommandItem
          value="close"
          shortcut="esc"
          >Close Overlay</CommandItem
        >
      </CommandGroup>
    </CommandList>
  </Command>
</template>
